extraction.notes: Q4 2025 three-month column from Attachment 2. Basic FFO (219,294) is a printed subtotal; the Series E preferred distribution (1,211) is added to reach diluted FFO (220,505), which is the figure used for FFO per share and the FFO as Adjusted start. I placed that distribution in the FFO section so ffo_total is the diluted figure; it is categorized as 'other'. Zero-valued lines printed as '-' (JV impairment, net gain on consolidation, provision for loan loss, software transition) are included at 0. Arithmetic checks: 220,505 + 6,923 = 227,428; 227,428 - 33,912 = 193,516; per-share checks 0.62, 0.64, 0.54 on 355,349 diluted shares.
